proposals.hypothesis: Li3PO4 is a wide-gap, electronically insulating lithium phosphate. It is expected to be chemically compatible with the Li6PS5Cl sulfide electrolyte and to resist oxidation near 4 V, so it is a standard protective coating for LiCoO2 in sulfide-based solid-state cells. Its phosphate chemistry is close to that of the sulfide electrolyte's PS4 units.
